summary: Frontend-only testing of SKIN.MRKT Item Detail Popup (F1-F8). Verified popup open on tile click, all 4 tabs (Details/Buy Orders/Similar/Sales), Origin section (The Train Collection + multiple Souvenir Package entries), Seller card with public visibility, seller profile page navigation, buy-order inline form, and popup close via Escape/X/backdrop. Core flows all pass.

ui_bugs.issue: Backdrop click in the top nav-header region (~top 60px) does NOT close the popup because the site header (LiveListings <Header/>) uses a fixed/sticky element that intercepts clicks even though popup is z-50. Result: user clicking near the top of the screen expecting to dismiss the modal has no effect. Clicks in any other backdrop region work correctly. Consider raising popup z-index above the header, or hiding/disabling header while modal is open.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Raise ItemDetailPopup wrapper z-index (or apply pointer-events: none to sticky header while a modal is open) so backdrop clicks near the top of the screen also dismiss the popup. Not blocking — Escape and the X button both work as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: ItemDetailPopup.jsx is 611 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider extracting PriceTrend, FloatBar, and per-tab bodies (DetailsTab, BuyOrdersTab, SimilarTab) into their own files for maintainability.

In ItemDetailPopup.jsx line 165: `AbortController` is created but never passed as a `signal` to any of the api.get() calls, so aborting it has no effect. Either wire it through the axios request configs or drop the controller.

Test note: reference request claimed the PP-Bizon listing has NO inspect_link and popup-inspect button should be absent — during testing the button rendered (count=1). Not a bug in the popup logic (it correctly conditions on `inspect_link`), just means live data does include an inspect_link for this listing. Please confirm whether the expectation or the data was wrong.

test_credentials: None used (all unauthenticated flows). Steam manual login available via POST /api/auth/steamid if E2E auth needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only 1 live listing exists (PP-Bizon Urban Dashed). Origin section renders both collections and crates arrays from /api/skins/detail-by-name. Popup properly cleans up body.overflow on unmount. If retesting, note that the reference expectation about popup-inspect being absent was wrong — the listing does have inspect_link. Header/nav intercepts clicks in top 60px preventing backdrop dismissal there.
rca of the issue: Minor backdrop-close blind-spot RCA: Header component in the app layout is rendered outside the popup React tree and is likely fixed/sticky. Popup is `fixed inset-0 z-50` but the site header appears to render at same or higher z (or is stacked in a way that captures pointer events in its bounds). Fix: while popup is mounted, either (a) increase popup wrapper z-index to 100+, or (b) set `document.body.classList.add('modal-open')` and add CSS `.modal-open header { pointer-events: none }`.
